title: SKF_RENAME_SKILL_RESULT_JSON envelope (v1)
description: Single-line JSON document skf-rename-skill emits when {headless_mode} is true, prefixed with the literal 'SKF_RENAME_SKILL_RESULT_JSON: ': on stdout when a rename finishes (step 3, report) and at the --dry-run exit (step 1, select), and on stderr at every HARD HALT. The shared emitter (skf-emit-result-envelope.py) builds every line from a staged payload and checks it against this schema, so pipelines branch on status, halt_reason and exit_code without grepping message text.

skf-envelope.description: The shared emitter's settings for this workflow, read by skf-emit-result-envelope.py: the workflow, the line's prefix, the status a halt carries, the exit code of each halt_reason and the result file stem. Nothing in the schema references this entry, so it constrains no envelope.

status.description: 'success' when the rename finished (step 3). 'dry-run' when --dry-run ended the run after the step 1 confirmation block, with nothing copied, re-keyed or deleted. 'error' on any HARD HALT, with halt_reason naming its class.

old_name.description: The skill being renamed. Null when the run halted before step 1 bound it.

new_name.description: The validated new name. Null when the run halted before step 1 bound it.

versions_renamed.description: On success, the versions whose package step 2 renamed, as step 2 recorded them from its own moves: a version folder without a package is copied but not listed. On a dry run, the versions the rename would touch. Empty on a halt.

manifest_rekeyed.description: True when step 2 re-keyed the skill's export manifest entry to the new name. False on a dry run and on a halt.

context_files_updated.description: The context files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules and the like) whose SKF managed section step 2 rebuilt. The rebuild is best-effort and never halts; a file that failed is reported in the step 3 report and the result file, not here. Empty on a dry run and on a halt.

exit_code.description: Process exit code, derived by the emitter from halt_reason through $defs.skf-envelope.exit_codes (0 when halt_reason is null). references/exit-codes.md says where each code is raised.

halt_reason.description: Null on success and on a dry run. One of the documented HALT classes otherwise. halted-for-concurrent-run fires while another rename of the same skill holds a fresh run lock (step 1), or when this run's lock went stale while it waited at a step 1 gate and another run may have taken it (step 2); error.reason names the run that holds the lock and when it goes stale, never a PID.

gate.description: The gate that auto-resolved: the step 1 source-authority warning or the step 1 confirmation gate. Matches the labels in the stage prose.

default_action.description: The action documented as the gate's default.

reason.description: Why the gate resolved without a person, for example 'headless auto-confirm'.

headless_decisions.description: One entry per gate that auto-resolved under {headless_mode}, recorded in the run folder's sink the moment the gate decided, so a halt still reports the decisions taken before it. Empty in interactive runs.

warnings.description: Optional. Non-fatal anomalies the run recorded, one string each, such as run-lock-replaced (step 1 took over a stale run lock), run-lock-not-released (a halt could not release the run lock), result_file_write_failed or customization_resolver_unavailable. Present only when the run recorded at least one.

run_id.description: The run's id, the UTC time the run started and a random suffix. It names the run folder, {project-root}/_bmad-output/.skf-run/skf-rename-skill-<run_id>/, which a halt leaves in place with its staged payloads, and it ends the run lock's owner.

result_path.description: The per-run result file step 3 wrote, rename-skill-result-<YYYYMMDD-HHmmss>.json beside rename-skill-result-latest.json in the renamed skill's folder. Null on a dry run, on a halt and when the file could not be written.

phase.description: The step and operation that halted, for example 'select:concurrency-guard' or 'execute:copy'.

path.description: The path the halt names, when it names one: the lock file, the manifest or a folder.

error.description: Optional. Present on a halt: the phase, the message and the path the halt names. Absent on success and on a dry run.
